description: Key facts a correct lesson on each Surveying and Geomatics topic must state. Every fact was taken from the fetched text of the source page named with it (the quote is checked by `npm run golden:check`). Patterns are case-insensitive regular expressions matched against the lesson text after LaTeX backslashes and braces are removed.
subject: surveying

facts.claim: Surveying fixes positions of points from distances and angles

source.quote: determining the terrestrial positions of points based on the distances and angles between them

facts.claim: Bearing is the horizontal angle from north, measured clockwise

source.quote: Absolute bearing refers to the clockwise angle between the magnetic north (magnetic bearing) or true north (true bearing) and an object

facts.claim: Levelling finds heights of points relative to a datum

source.quote: measure the height of specified points relative to a d

facts.claim: Over long sights, Earth's curvature and refraction must be corrected

source.quote: the curvature of the Earth, and the refraction of the instrument wave through the air must be taken into account

facts.claim: A contour joins points of equal elevation

source.quote: a contour line (often just called a "contour") joins points of equal elevation (height)

facts.claim: Contour interval = elevation difference between successive contours

source.quote: The contour interval of a contour map is the difference in elevation between successive contour lines

facts.claim: A theodolite measures horizontal and vertical angles

source.quote: is a precision optical instrument for measuring angles between designated visible points in the horizontal and vertical planes

facts.claim: Triangulation fixes a point from angles at the ends of a known baseline

source.quote: by measuring only angles to it from known points at either end of a fixed baseline

facts.claim: Degree of curve: central angle for a standard arc or chord length

source.quote: The degree of curvature is defined as the central angle to the ends of an agreed length of either an arc or a chord

facts.claim: A total station = electronic theodolite + EDM

source.quote: It is an electronic transit theodolite integrated with electronic distance measurement (EDM)

facts.claim: GNSS includes GPS, GLONASS, BeiDou and Galileo

source.quote: There are four operational GNSS systems: the United States Global Positioning System (GPS), Russia's Global Navigation Satellite System (GLONASS)

facts.claim: Measurements from photographs (3D from overlapping images)

source.quote: obtaining reliable information about physical objects and the environment through the process of recording, measuring and interpreting photographic
Remote sensing is the acquisition of information about an object or phenomenon without making physical contact with the object

facts.claim: A GIS stores, analyses and displays geographic (spatial) data

source.quote: consists of integrated computer hardware and software that store, manage, analyze, edit, output, and visualize geographic data
